caption: The drawing depicts a decorative architectural element, likely a corbel or ornamental bracket, attached to a flat surface such as the underside of a shelf or overhang. The object is composed of geometric and curvilinear shapes outlined in dark lines, featuring a variety of colors including shades of green, pink, beige, and brown. The uppermost edge consists of a brown and gold rectangular band representing the base or shelf, beneath which lies a large central panel painted in a deep green with lighter green accents. Flanking either side of the central green area are vertical panels in a muted pink, bordered by beige or off-white lines. Additional beige and green molding details are present along the edges, forming scroll-like volute shapes. The overall composition is symmetrical, with both sides mirroring each other, and the drawing is rendered against a plain, light background. The name “EDUARDO T. JEWETT” is printed in small letters in the lower right area of the image.
title: Wall Bracket (Ecclesiastical)
